patch.summary:
Choose Adobe Firefly only if your buying job matches “Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99;” rather than Claude's shape. Choose Claude only if your buying job matches “LLM assistant with strong writing and reasoning — Free; Pro $20/mo ($17 annual); Max from ” rather than Adobe Firefly's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Firefly leans ai-image; Claude leans llm-assistant. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Adobe Firefly is Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99; also bundled in Creative Cloud.; Claude is LLM assistant with strong writing and reasoning — Free; Pro $20/mo ($17 annual); Max from $100; Team Standard $20/seat annual ($25 monthly, .
- Company-size focus: Adobe Firefly (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Claude (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Firefly-leaning ai-image vs Claude-leaning llm-assistant.
- Researched limits: Adobe Firefly — Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Claude — Free tier usage caps limit heavy document and coding workflows.

Limitations — Adobe Firefly: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Standalone pricing is easy to confuse with Creative Cloud Pro bundles; Claude: Free tier usage caps limit heavy document and coding workflows; Team Standard enforces 2-seat minimum on paid team packaging.

Poor-fit cases: Adobe Firefly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans · Claude is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free tier usage caps limit heavy document and coding workflows · Avoid Adobe Firefly if you actually need Claude's motion (LLM assistant with strong writing and reasoning — Free; Pro $20/mo ($17 annual);)
